overview_description.description:
Pocus is a revenue data platform for go-to-market teams to analyze, visualize, and action data about their prospects and customers without needing engineers. 

Pocus helps companies like Miro, Webflow, Loom, and Superhuman focus their sales and success teams on the highest priority opportunities by surfacing insights at the right moment so reps can take quick action. Pocus gives you a 360-degree view of product usage, empowering you to act on insights and fill your funnel efficiently. Sales teams save 10+ hours/week digging through data to surface millions in new revenue opportunities.

about_short_description.short_description: Pocus is a revenue data platform for go-to-market teams to analyze and act on revenue data from prospects and customers.

product.name: Pocus AI
product.description: An AI-driven platform that analyzes revenue data to surface relevant sales opportunities and provide actionable insights for go-to-market teams.

product.name: List Builder
product.description: A tool to create targeted prospect lists by combining CRM data with external accounts and contacts for streamlined prospecting.

product.name: Intent Alerts
product.description: AI-powered alerts that monitor accounts continuously and notify reps of significant events to prioritize engagement.

product.name: Playbooks
product.description: Configurable sales playbooks that automate workflows and guide reps through data-driven engagement strategies.

product.name: AI Message Generation
product.description: An AI feature that drafts personalized outreach messages for LinkedIn, email, and cold calls based on company frameworks.
